messages:
sophia: quick async pulse — brief status + asks for the runtime perf sprint. kernel PR (#842) needs 2nd review, continuous-batching flag is in staging but not stable, and kv cache warmup still shows cold-start misses. owners: kernel=leo, batching=marta, kv=anya. milestones: M1 fix perf regressions by Fri EOD, M2 canary at 20% next Mon. questions below.

leo: on #842 now. blocked by a perf regression in the short-seq path — local perf shows median up by ~0.9ms (from 2.3 -> 3.2). failing test: `tests/perf/test_short_seq_latency.py::test_med_latency` — attaching perf log snippet: `perf_ms: [2.1,2.3,3.2,2.9]`. investigating kernel scheduling interaction.

marta: staging flag is `feature.continuous_batching_v2`. it's behind a gate controlled by infra. also we saw one canary pod hit batch size overflow with `--max-batch-tokens=4096`. we should try 2048 first and measure.

alex-infra: will flip the flag in staging at 15:30 PT. also queued a canary change with `--max-batch-tokens=2048` and `--batch-window-ms=8`. deploy bot says: queued -> see deploy note below.

anya: kv warmup notes: on cold pods cache hit ramps to ~95% after ~90s, but in the canary we saw ~30% misses for first ~30s on heavy fanout. PR #857 adds a prefetch heuristic that primes hot keys. I'm validating under load now.

sam: dependency note — the prefetch heuristic relies on a small kv API change (async prefetch hook) that is in the kernel PR. @leo can you confirm ordering? if kernel change isn't merged first, batching will fallback to sync fetch (bad).

leo: confirmed. PR #842 exposes `kv.prefetch_async` shim. without it continuous batching falls back to sync fetch path. i've added a small shim so prefetch calls are noop-safe, but perf benefits need the full kernel commit.

marta: can we add an ownership matrix in each PR description? quick fields: rollout-owner, test-owner, perf-owner, rollback-plan. will help cross-team signoff.

sophia: yes please add that. and also add short ETA lines (ex: "review by today", "canary Mon") so triage can follow.

dev-bot: deploy queued for staging at 2024-10-05T22:30Z by alex-infra :rocket: (canary group: 1 pod -> 3 pods)

anya: quick Q: what's our target SLO for per-token tail? link to perf SLOs would help.

leo: perf SLO is 99th <= 75ms for short sequences (per docs). if we breach that we block canary.

olivia: pinging reviewers — I can take a pass on #857 this afternoon if you add the metrics (kv.prefetch.misses, kv.prefetch.latency_ms) and remove the debug logs.

jun: noted, i'll coordinate risk signoff with product for the canary window. will update the escalation contact list in the ticket.

sam: i'll review #842 after lunch; if i hit blockers i'll leave inline comments and assign follow-ups.

sophia: thanks all — actions: 1) leo: finish kernel perf fix + comment ETA on #842; 2) marta: confirm staging flag flip + measure after 2048 patch; 3) anya: finish prefetch validation and push metrics; 4) alex-infra: flip flag at 15:30 PT and monitor; 5) reviewers (olivia/sam): review PRs today. please update PR descriptions with ownership matrix and put ETA in this thread. :thumbsup:
